title: Data Engineer
text:
Northwind Logistics runs freight analytics for retailers across North America. Our Data Platform team is looking for a Data Engineer.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines (ETL/ELT) with Airflow, Spark and Kafka.
- Model data in Snowflake with dbt; own data quality checks and documentation.
- Work with analysts to ship dashboards in Looker and Tableau.
- Optimize SQL for cost and speed; manage storage in S3 using Parquet and Delta Lake.
- Write Python for ingestion services and data validation; deploy with Terraform and GitHub Actions.

What you bring
- 3+ years in data engineering.
- Expert SQL and Python; experience with data warehousing and data modeling.
- Experience with Databricks or BigQuery is a plus.
- Familiarity with Docker and Linux.
- Excellent communication skills.

We sponsor visas for this role. Location: Chicago, IL (hybrid).
